caption: The drawing depicts three glass bottles, all rendered in shades of light blue-green with darker outlines and highlights suggesting transparency and reflection, set against a beige background. Two of the bottles are shown standing upright, while the third is displayed lying horizontally with its neck pointing to the right. The upright bottle on the left shows the embossed text "JENNY LIND" above an embossed relief of a woman's bust, with a laurel-like decoration below. The upright bottle on the right has the embossed text "PASERVILLE GLASS WORKS" encircling the image of a building with a plume of smoke rising from its chimney. The bottle lying horizontally displays portions of both inscriptions, "JENNY LIND" and "PASERVILLE," on its visible sides, and gives a clear view of the bottle's overall oval, flattened shape. All three bottles have narrow necks and rounded shoulders, and each bottle appears to be of similar shape and size. The signature "P. Ward" and the note "abt. 2/3 SIZE" are written in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jenny Lind Bottle
